denormImg: denormalize a torch image tensor back to a uint8 numpy array and display it
visSMPLoutput_bboxSpace: visualize an SMPL mesh and skeleton in bounding box space using glViewer
getSMPLoutput_bboxSpace: compute SMPL body mesh vertices and joints in 2D bounding box space from prediction output

renderSMPLoutput: render SMPL mesh or skeleton output to side or overlaid images and save to disk
